title: Sources of water
log: 2026-11-20T12:15:15Z match: Claude Haiku 5.5 found no bank point the same, so it is written new

match.reason: No bank point teaches the list of fresh water sources the brief asks for: geo-forms-water covers where Earth's water is held, and geo-managing-water-sustainably covers managing supply, so both are related but a different idea.

draft.title: Sources of water
card: Fresh water comes from rivers, lakes and groundwater. Groundwater is water stored under the ground, which people reach with bores and wells.
A dam is a wall built across a river to hold back water in a large store. The stored water can be used when rain is low.
Rainwater tanks collect rain from a roof. Households can use the water for gardens and some other jobs.
Desalination plants remove salt from seawater to make fresh water. Recycled water is used water that has been treated so it can be used again.
draft.remember: Water comes from rivers, lakes, dams and groundwater, and also from tanks, desalination and recycling.

a.q: A town in the outback drills a bore and pumps up water from under the ground. What is its source?
a.why: Water stored under the ground is groundwater, and a bore reaches it. Recycled water is treated used water, which is not what is pumped from a bore.
a.clue: Where is the water being taken from?

b.q: A coastal city treats seawater to remove the salt and adds it to its supply. Which source is this?
b.why: Removing salt from seawater is desalination. Recycled water is tempting because it is also treated, but it starts as used water, not seawater.
b.clue: What is taken out of the water?
